subject: Four distinct explorable Opera House screens and living ambient motion
decision: Develop a plan and present a playable v1 through Godot AI: four screens with unique drawings in a 2 x 2 arrangement, Roshan exploration rather than static-canvas selection, and subtle animation preserving the original Opera identity. Earlier above-door icon and room-completion feedback corrections remain applicable. This review commission does not itself accept unseen artwork or a release.
question: Owner directly commissioned the redesign and evaluation demo; no approval question was required.
